title: Payment Fraud Detection
short_description: A web application that analyses payment data and identifies potentially fraudulent transactions using machine learning.
description: A practical fraud-detection project focused on turning transaction data into a clear, usable prediction workflow.
problem: Payment systems need a fast way to flag suspicious transactions without making the user experience complicated.
approach: Build a lightweight Flask application around a machine-learning prediction flow, then present the result through a simple web interface.
result: A portfolio-ready end-to-end ML web application that connects a prediction model with a usable frontend.

title: Course2Career
short_description: A student-focused platform concept for exploring careers, skills and personalised learning paths.
description: A career-discovery experience designed to help students understand possible career directions and the skills needed to reach them.
problem: Students often know what they want to study but struggle to connect courses, skills and realistic career paths.
approach: Organise career exploration into a visual, student-friendly flow with recommendations, learning resources and an AI-assisted experience.
result: A product concept focused on making career planning more approachable and actionable for students.

title: Jal Raksha
short_description: A water-conservation application concept built to promote awareness and responsible water usage.
description: A community-minded app concept that turns water conservation into a simple digital awareness experience.
problem: Water conservation is an everyday responsibility, but awareness needs to be easy to understand and act on.
approach: Create a simple mobile experience that communicates conservation ideas in an accessible format.
result: A purpose-driven application concept connecting technology with environmental awareness.

title: Time Bank App
short_description: A community-focused platform concept for exchanging time and services through a simple digital experience.
description: A community platform concept where people can exchange skills and services through time rather than traditional payment.
problem: People have useful skills and time to offer, but communities need a simple way to discover and exchange those contributions.
approach: Design a straightforward web experience around profiles, service exchange and community participation.
result: A social-impact product concept exploring how software can make local skill exchange easier.
